decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed detached house by reason of its position, scale, massing, bulk, design, and cramped appearance, would not be in keeping with the form, character, and style of surrounding development and would therefore be harmful to the street scene.  It is therefore contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development), and supplementary planning guidance of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed detached house by reason of its position, size and scale, would be harmful to neighbouring residents' living conditions by reason of having an overbearing appearance, causing overlooking, and loss of outlook.  It is therefore contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development), of the adopted unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development would provide inadequate private garden space for the occupiers of the detached house.   It is therefore contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development), and supplementary planning guidance of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a detached two bedroom house with associated parking.
